 Europa League AZ Alkmaar vs Juventus live online: score, stats, goals & updates | Europa League 2026/27
 Juventus put their unbeaten Europa League start to the test against an AZ side undefeated in 17 European home games.
 AS USA Update: Nov 5th, 2026 14:20 EST 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google AZ Alkmaar and Juventus meet for the first time, separated by only one point in the Europa League standings. The Dutch side have won two of their opening three games, while Juventus remain unbeaten after collecting seven points.
 AZ’s formidable European home record adds another layer to the contest: they have gone 17 continental games without defeat in Alkmaar. The occasion is also a family affair for Juventus midfielder Teun Koopmeiners, who lines up against his younger brother Peer.
